proposal_summary: Fixed _contained_destination in approve.py to resolve the destination's parent (following ancestor symlinks/aliases) and rejoin the final component, instead of lexically comparing the unresolved destination against the repo root. This makes the helper both accept alias paths and return a value run() can safely pass through destination.relative_to(root) in the issuance and --recover-output paths. Added a new test module exercising the alias case end-to-end through run(argv) --preflight, the helper's return-value contract, and the existing rejection behaviors (outside path, inside-symlink-pointing-outside, final-component symlink, relative path), all via real filesystem symlinks with no git dependency.
